shortDescription: Jamie Dimon praised Tata Sons Pvt. Chairman Natarajan Chandrasekaran and said the governance conflict at one of India’s oldest conglomerates could dent foreign investor confidence, according to Bloomberg.The JPMorgan Chase & Co. chief made the comments in an interview with the Economic Times.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Dimon Praises Chandrasekaran, Warns Tata Governance Rift May Hurt Investment
